prompt: Assess claim #CLM-88421, a ₹4.2L car-collision claim filed yesterday. Should we fast-track settlement, and at what amount? And flag anything suspicious.

assessment.policy_terms_used: Policy P-2231 version 1 in force on loss date 2026-10-12: MOTOR_COMP, Hyundai Creta MH12AB4321, IDV ₹11,20,000, zero-depreciation not in force, deductible ₹2,500. Endorsement END-5512 changed zero-depreciation to true effective 2026-10-13 10:42, after the loss.
assessment.severity_reading: B2, from the surveyor severity_band in silver.claims; assessed loss ₹4,10,000.

evidence.detail: Open collision claim; loss date 2026-10-12, filed date 2026-10-14, requested ₹4,20,000, assessed ₹4,10,000, severity B2, vehicle MH12AB4321, policy P-2231.
Version 1 was in force on the loss date with zero-depreciation off and ₹2,500 deductible; zero-depreciation was added only by END-5512 on 2026-10-13 10:42.

Latest registered support includes FIR fir-copy-88421.pdf, invoice IMG_4417.pdf (version 2), and survey survey_report_SV118.pdf. The available tools classified these documents but did not expose their contents for reading.
Decision recorded as hold_and_route_to_investigation; no payment authorized.

assessment.summary: Do not fast-track or pay at this stage. The loss is within the ₹5 lakh fast-track ceiling and is rated B2, but the post-loss zero-depreciation endorsement is a concrete red flag: zero-depreciation was not applicable on 2026-10-12, then was added before filing on 2026-10-14. Route to investigation; if the assessed ₹4,10,000 is confirmed as the eligible gross loss, the policy deductible implies ₹4,07,500 before any other policy adjustments.

decisions.rationale: Loss occurred 2026-10-12, before the zero-depreciation endorsement effective 2026-10-13 10:42; the policy terms in force at loss had zero-depreciation off and a ₹2,500 deductible. The claim was filed 2026-10-14, and this post-loss endorsement is a concrete coverage/fraud red flag requiring investigation; no fraud score or linked-claim result was available from the governed tools.
